issue.title: src/sase/ace agent instruction files name a Vim syntax path that does not exist (chezmoi saseproject.vim)
issue.description:
src/sase/ace/AGENTS.md (and its identical CLAUDE/GEMINI/OPENCODE/QWEN shims) lists 'home/dot_config/nvim/syntax/saseproject.vim' in the chezmoi repo as styling surface #1 of the four that MUST be updated whenever a Patch field spelling or suffix type changes. That file does not exist: 'find <chezmoi> -iname "*saseproject*"' returns nothing, and chezmoi's home/dot_config/nvim/syntax/ holds only auto/gdb/nasm/shv/syslog/text/weechat/yaml/zorg/zorq.vim. The real ProjectSpec Vim syntax file is 'syntax/sase_gp.vim' in the linked sase-nvim repo (ftdetect/sase_gp.lua maps .sase/projects/*.sase to filetype sase_gp).

IMPACT: an agent that follows the instruction looks in chezmoi, finds nothing, and skips the surface. That already happened: epic sase-jd phase sase-jd.3 recorded PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP 'Restore PR_ORIGIN Vim syntax styling surface -- linked chezmoi checkout lacks home/dot_config/nvim/syntax/saseproject.vim or an obvious generated source for this plan item', and PR_ORIGIN shipped without Vim styling. sase-jd's land agent added it to sase-nvim/syntax/sase_gp.vim; the stale instruction remains.

SCOPE: correct the path in the canonical source for src/sase/ace's agent instruction files to sase-nvim's syntax/sase_gp.vim (opened via /sase_repo), note that it is a linked repo rather than chezmoi, and regenerate the five identical shims (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, OPENCODE.md, QWEN.md are byte-identical today). Editing agent instruction files requires explicit user permission, which is why sase-jd's land agent filed this instead of fixing it.

Discovered by: epic sase-jd land agent (proposing bead: sase-jd.3), workspace sase_11 at HEAD eadb54323.
